thread:
**Issue #3982 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3982: Patch: spec 51's R3728000 screenshots stop waiting for a screen at 1366x1024
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

`e2e/cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts`, `R3728000 screenshots` at `ipad-landscape-1366x1024`, visits /, /play and /collection signed in. It fails often in `e2e smoke (4/4)` because a screen's root never shows within `timeouts.view` (10 s), and on PR #3965 it failed on both attempts.

## Evidence

- [Job 132849517245](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43725572168/job/132849517245) (PR #3965, 2026-11-15) failed on both attempts:
  - Attempt 1 stopped after the home shot, on the Play leg.
  - Attempt 2 stopped on Collection: `AssertionError: Timed out retrying after 10000ms: Expected to find element: [data-testid="collection-screen"], but never found it.` at `51-menu-shell.cy.ts:137:55`.
  - The spec's two other tests at 1366x1024 also load /collection and wait for `collection-screen`, and both passed in the same job.
  - That PR changes nothing at runtime in the client.
- In the merge queue on `main`, attempt 1 of this test failed and the retry passed in 4 of the 7 `e2e smoke (4/4)` logs read:
  - [132850547664](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43726216341/job/132850547664). Its attempt 1 also stopped after the home shot.
  - [132844906912](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43724372114/job/132844906912).
  - [132825879532](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43718266275/job/132825879532).
  - [132818589431](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43715711437/job/132818589431).
  - The spec's R3728001 test needed a retry at other sizes in 5 of those 7 logs.

## What to find out

This test runs three `cy.visitAs` calls back to back at every size, so it signs in and loads the client more often than any other test in the spec. The spec's own comment warns about the server's rate limit (R109).
- Read `server.log` in the failed job's `cypress-smoke-4-of-4` artifact. Did a 429, or a slow sign-in, hold the screen back?
- If it did, the fix is in the spec's setup (fewer sign-ins, or the fixture's limit). If it didn't, find what keeps the root from rendering.

Don't skip the test or raise its retries to get green (CLAUDE.md; the PR rules).

Found while landing #3965 (#3836's mutation audit).

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44834717266)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

The `R3728000 screenshots` test in spec 51 visits `/`, `/play` and `/collection` with a full page load each, three loads back-to-back per size, and times out waiting for a screen root at `ipad-landscape-1366x1024` when the gate never reaches `ready`. Decide from local evidence whether the rotation fix already on main cured it, and if not, remove the cause in the spec's own setup: fewer full page loads per size, so no account spends its R109 budget inside one minute. No skip, no retry or timeout raise, no server or client change.

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes there |
|---|---|---|
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts` | change | `R3728000 screenshots` test: one `cy.visitAs` plus in-place `navItem` clicks instead of three `visitAs`; the `SIGNED_IN`/R109 comment block above it |

Do not touch: `crates/server` (especially `API_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE` in `crates/server/src/config.rs`), `apps/web`, `e2e/cypress.config.ts` (retries), `e2e/support/config.ts` (`timeouts`), `e2e/support/shell.ts`, anything under `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`. Governing spec: §9.8 with R109 (300 requests/minute per account) and R192 (429 with `Retry-After`), R3728000 (the shell and its screenshots), R2630000/R3206000 (the gate keeps `GET /api/auth/me` 45 s) and R2125000 (kept answers). No new ruling: this decides no game rule.

## Steps

1. Confirm the history from the local clone (no GitHub access exists here, so do not try to fetch job logs): `git show 70985031 --stat` is the rotation fix (PR #4122, `SIGNED_IN` from `accounts.p1` to the four-account rotation); `git show 47478580a9 --stat` proves PR #4240 touched only `crates/server` plus `spec/` and never spec 51, so the issue comment's "(spec 51 changed in #4240)" names the wrong PR and the relevant change is #4122.
2. Reproduce locally as `e2e/README.md` says: `E2E=1 cargo run --release -p jackioh-server`, then `pnpm --dir apps/web build:e2e` and `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vite preview --port 5173 --strictPort` (a plain `build` strips `window.__jackioh` and every spec fails; serve the built client, not `dev`, since the file will be edited). Run `cd e2e && pnpm exec cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts` twice and grep the local server log for `429`/`rate_limited` with the account and timestamp of any failing leg.
3. Read the result: a 429 on `GET /api/auth/me` (or on the first screen read) on the failing leg means the gate rendered `GateError` instead of the root (`Gated` in `apps/web/src/main.tsx` renders the screen only on `kind === "ready"`; signed-in Play and Collection are `Gated engine`, while the landing at `main.tsx:652` is ungated, which is why the home shot passes and the Play leg dies first). `readCache` is tab-memory-only (`apps/web/src/net/readCache.ts:1`), so each `cy.visitAs` (`e2e/support/commands.ts:742`) re-fires the full read set. No 429 and request counts with headroom mean #4122 already fixed it: stop, change nothing, and report the numbers for a person to close the issue.
4. Only if step 3 still shows a 429 or near-limit rate, edit the `R3728000 screenshots` test (lines 137–145): replace the `for` loop's `cy.visitAs(signedIn(), path())` with a single `cy.visitAs(signedIn(), routes.landing())` followed by in-place navigation using the file's own `navItem` helper and `DESTINATIONS` pattern from the `R3728000 Home...` test (lines 93–101): visit landing, assert `landingTestid.root`, run `fanDealt()`, run `expectShellNav(true)`, screenshot `home`; then `navItem(menuShellTestid.play).click()`, assert the location is `routes.play()` and `PLAY_HUB` is visible, run `expectShellNav(true)`, screenshot `play`; then the same through `navItem(menuShellTestid.collection)` for `COLLECTION_SCREEN`. Keep the `home → play → collection` order and every assertion the loop made.
5. In the same file, rewrite the R109 comment block (lines 20–26) to state the new accounting: each size costs two full loads in the first two tests plus one in the screenshots test (in-place moves reuse the gate's kept answer inside `READ_CACHE_FRESH_MS`, `apps/web/src/net/readCache.ts:23`), and the four-account rotation keeps every account at about two sizes a minute. Leave `SIGNED_IN`, the other two tests (the Back leg needs its fresh load without `CloseWatcher`), `SHOTS` aside from its use, timeouts and retries exactly as they are.
6. Typecheck and re-run: `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck`, then the step-2 Cypress run twice; grep the server log for `429` and confirm all seven sizes pass both attempts with per-account request counts well under 300/minute.

## Tests

- `e2e/cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts`, `R3728000 screenshots`: the flaky test itself; must pass at all seven `MENU_SIZES` on consecutive local runs with no 429 for its account in the server log.
- Same file, `R3728000 Home, Play, Collection, Shop are one tap away and Friends opens in place` and `R3728001 the drawer closes on Escape, Back and a tap outside`: regression only, unchanged behavior.
- Commands: `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` and `cd e2e && pnpm exec cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts` (with the E2E server and `build:e2e` client from Steps). No Rust or web unit tests cover this change; no `spec check` input changes.

## Done when

- The wrong-PR note (#4240 vs #4122) is verified from `git show` output.
- The cause is named from local evidence: a 429 in the local server log on the failing leg, or measured request counts proving headroom.
- If a code change was needed, the screenshots test does one full load per size, all seven sizes pass twice locally with no 429, and `pnpm --dir e2e typecheck` is green.
- Retries (`e2e/cypress.config.ts`), `timeouts.view`, `API_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE`, and every `spec/` note are byte-identical; the diff touches only `e2e/cypress/e2e/51-menu-shell.cy.ts`.
- Every decision below is recorded in the final report with its rejected alternative.

## Risks

- In-place navigation renders the same roots (`PlayRoute` and `CollectionRoute` draw their `data-testid` divs before their reads resolve), but cold-load rendering gets one fewer exercise per size per screen; the first two tests still cold-load every size twice, which keeps that coverage.
- Kept answers (`R2125000`) can make a navigated-to screen paint from cache; the pixels asserted by the screenshots are the same shells and rails, and `expectShellNav(true)` still runs per screen.
- Local runs cannot reproduce CI load or the merge-queue shard layout, so a local green plus request-count headroom is evidence, not proof, against a run of bad luck; the 429-or-headroom log reading in Step 3 is what separates the two outcomes.

## Open questions

- Closing the issue (with the CI links the comment asks for) needs a person with GitHub access: this environment holds no credential and must not try. If Step 3 shows #4122 already fixed it, the builder changes nothing and hands the local evidence to that person.
- If the local server log shows the root blocked with no 429 (a slow `GET /api/auth/me` or engine-chunk load past 10 s), that is a different cause from the one the issue names; report the timings rather than reshaping the spec to hide them.
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->

Decision: worth fixing. A test that fails both attempts blocks the merge queue, and the retries cost shared runner time on every pull request.

Otherwise find the cause as the issue says, from server.log in the cypress-smoke-4-of-4 artifact or by reproducing it locally. Don't skip the test or raise its retries.
